name: Pulse Lab: Tracker Face-Off
subtitle: Compare sleep, HRV & recovery
promotionalText: Wear a smartwatch and a WHOOP? See which one you can trust: resting heart rate, HRV, sleep, SpO₂ and calories side by side, day by day.
description:
Pulse Lab puts your Apple Watch data and your WHOOP data side by side, so you can finally see where they agree, where they split, and which one to trust for each number.

TODAY AT A GLANCE
Recovery, readiness, sleep, resting heart rate, HRV and strain from both trackers on one screen, with a plain-English Lab note about what stands out today.

SLEEP, HEART AND MOVES
Sleep stages and duration, resting heart rate, HRV, respiratory rate, blood oxygen, wrist temperature, steps, active calories and workouts. Every chart shows both trackers in their own colors.

THE VS LAB
Day-by-day agreement scores for resting heart rate, HRV, sleep, SpO₂, respiratory rate, temperature and calories, and a running scoreboard of who's winning. "Who to trust" explains which tracker is the better source for each metric, backed by your own numbers.

YOUR SUPPLEMENT STACK
List what you take, check it off each day and Pulse Lab saves it to the Health app as nutrients (vitamin D, magnesium and more). Stack insights compare the next morning's recovery after days you took something versus days you didn't.

EVERY NUMBER, IN ONE PLACE
The All data screen lists every metric Pulse Lab syncs with a 7-day sparkline and where it came from. Data check shows exactly what is arriving from the Health app and from WHOOP, so an empty chart is never a mystery.

LOG WHOOP BY HAND
No WHOOP connection? Type in the morning's recovery, sleep and strain in seconds, from a morning reminder or with Siri.

SHARE AND EXPORT
Post the VS scoreboard as a clean card, or export everything as a CSV for your own spreadsheet. Widgets keep today's scores on your Home Screen.

FREE AND PRO
Today, Sleep, Heart, Moves and Stack, with both trackers side by side for 30 days, are free. Pulse Lab Pro adds the VS lab, Who to trust, 90-day and 1-year history, share cards and CSV export. Choose monthly or yearly (with a free first week for new subscribers) or a one-time lifetime unlock. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled; cancel anytime in Settings › your name › Subscriptions at least 24 hours before the period ends.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no analytics, no servers. Health data and WHOOP data go straight to your iPhone and stay there.

Pulse Lab needs the Health app data your watch records; WHOOP data needs a WHOOP membership. Pulse Lab is an independent app, not affiliated with or endorsed by WHOOP. It is for general wellness and is not a medical device.
reviewNotes:
No account or sign-in for Pulse Lab itself.

HealthKit: Pulse Lab reads heart, sleep, activity and workout data to compare trackers, and writes only the supplements a person checks off in the Stack tab (as dietary nutrients). On a device with no Health data the screens show empty states; launch on a phone paired with an Apple Watch for real data.

WHOOP is optional: Settings › Connect WHOOP uses WHOOP's own OAuth sign-in (a WHOOP membership is required). Without WHOOP, every screen still works with Health data, and Log WHOOP lets you enter numbers by hand.

Pro: auto-renewable monthly (com.troydunn.pulselab.pro.monthly) and yearly (com.troydunn.pulselab.pro.yearly) with a 1-week free trial as Apple's introductory offer, plus the one-time lifetime unlock (com.troydunn.pulselab.pro). Tap the VS tab, any lock icon, or Settings › Pulse Lab Pro to see the plans; Restore and Manage Subscription are on the same screen.
